# AvatarGroup

> Who is involved, without a list. Medium Avatars overlapping by 8px, each ringed in the page colour, and how many more.

## Install

It lands in `src/rost/avatar-group/`, with what it needs and its contract. In an app that uses shadcn:

```sh
npx shadcn add https://rost.build/r/avatar-group.json
```

Then import `src/rost/fonts.css` and `src/rost/tokens.css` once, at the root of the app. More on this in [Install](../INSTALL.md).

## Props

| Prop | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| `people` | slot |  |  |
| `max` | number |  | `3` |

## Anatomy

- `root`: A row. It starts 8px in, so the first Avatar sits flush after each one pulls 8px back.
- `avatar`: A medium Avatar, pulled 8px over the one before, with a 2px ring in the page colour to keep them apart.
- `more`: How many more, in a 40px circle like a medium Avatar's.

## When to use

- **Who's on it.** The people on a project or the clients in a group, where the count matters more than the names.

## When not to use

- **A list of people.** When the names matter, write them out, with a small Avatar beside each.

## Behaviour

Up to `max` Avatars, overlapping, then +N for the rest.

## Accessibility

- **Element**: A `<div role="group">` labelled with all the names, so the hidden ones are read too.
- **Name**: Every name, in the group's label.
- **Colour**: The +N is 9:1 on its grey.
